result:
Perfect! The test is now **failing on the actual bug** as required. The test clearly reproduces the issue:

**Expected:** `"https://newhost.com/graphql"` (only selected portion replaced)
**Actual:** `"https://newhost.com/graphqlhttps://api.example.com/graphql"` (document corrupted by inserting from position 0)

This demonstrates the bug described in the triage hypothesis: the `filterNewLine` transaction filter incorrectly rebuilds the paste transaction with `from: 0`, inserting the entire document from the beginning instead of respecting the original selection.

## Summary

```json
{
  "testFilePath": "packages/altair-app/src/app/modules/altair/components/x-input/x-input.repro.spec.ts",
  "expectedBehavior": "When pasting 'newhost.com' over selected text 'api.example.com' in URL 'https://api.example.com/graphql', only the selected portion should be replaced, resulting in 'https://newhost.com/graphql'",
  "actualBehavior": "The filter incorrectly rebuilds the paste transaction with `from: 0`, inserting the entire new document from the beginning, resulting in corrupted output: 'https://newhost.com/graphqlhttps://api.example.com/graphql'"
}
```
